Occasionally mix in other genres such as action (battling supernatural threats), drama (emotional fallout from horror), or romance (a doomed love story in a terrifying setting). Ensure diversity by including different horror sub-genres (e.g., supernatural, slasher, psychological thriller) and cultural influences (e.g., Western gothic vs. Asian horror tropes). Vary the tone (e.g., terrified, intrigued, or darkly humorous) and reviewer style (e.g., analytical critic, scared viewer, or horror enthusiast) to reflect varied responses.
